scope: Canonical reuse and ownership index for Nex evidence, identity, communication, orchestration, and MoonSleep operational objects used by the reviewed-interpretation tracks. It points to owning schemas and read contracts; it does not copy their data or create a parallel business model.

new_object_requirements: record the registry searches and rejected candidates
prove a distinct stable identity and canonical owner
define revision and relationship cardinality semantics
define evidence, Observation, projection, and action boundaries
provide an alias or migration plan and cross-domain review

repositories.role: Publishes cross-repository contracts and this registry
Owns Nex runtime primitives, APIs, and storage
Owns MoonSleep domain contracts and PostgreSQL operational resources

entries.definition: Stable source-object envelope for one provider record identity. It is evidence, not a business Resource. Exact immutable payload custody belongs to Record Revision.
entries.stable_identity: Nex record ID plus unique provider platform and provider record ID
entries.observation_head_rule: Records are Observation evidence, never Observation targets by default.
forbidden_parallel_objects: domain-local copies of source messages or provider rows

entries.definition: Immutable capture of one exact provider payload version, including content digest, source/capture timing, registration receipt, and attachment revision membership. Episodes bind Record Revisions, not mutable search results.
entries.revision_identity: Content-addressed immutable revision; no in-place successor mutation
entries.observation_head_rule: Exact revisions support Facts and Episode membership.
forbidden_parallel_objects: hash-only domain evidence rows presented as canonical revision custody

entries.definition: File or media evidence attached to a source Record, with immutable content identity and optional interpretation kept separate from the binary custody.
entries.stable_identity: Record ID plus attachment ID; content hash detects exact binary identity
entries.revision_identity: Attachment revision follows its owning Record Revision
entries.observation_head_rule: Attachment fragments support Facts; interpretations do not replace binary evidence.
forbidden_parallel_objects: treating one PDF as one Invoice or Claim

entries.definition: Cross-platform identity for a person, organization, agent, or other identity-bearing actor. Platform Contacts point to an Entity; merges are explicit and historical.
entries.revision_identity: Explicit update/merge history; merged_into preserves canonicalization
entries.observation_head_rule: Stable tuple of Entity ID and attribute or typed relationship slot.
forbidden_parallel_objects: Customer rows that duplicate an existing Entity

entries.canonical_owner: Nex Identity and owning business domain
entries.definition: Effective role classification attached to an Entity, such as Customer, Shopify, supplier, carrier, or partner. A role does not create a second Entity.
entries.stable_identity: Entity ID plus active role/tag value
entries.observation_head_rule: Entity ID plus role slot and value.
forbidden_parallel_objects: standalone Customer identity when Customer is an Entity role

entries.definition: Platform- and space-scoped address or account through which an Entity is observed or contacted. Shopify and Gmail Contacts can represent the same Entity without being the same Contact.
entries.stable_identity: platform plus space_id plus contact_id, represented by immutable Contact row ID
entries.revision_identity: Contact observations retain seen names and platform aliases
entries.observation_head_rule: Contact row ID plus attribute or relationship slot.

entries.definition: Immutable observation that a platform contact identity, name, or alias was seen and resolved or proposed against a Contact and Entity.
entries.observation_head_rule: Identity custody evidence is append-only and is not a semantic business-field Observation.
forbidden_parallel_objects: silent Contact-to-Entity merge based only on a matching string

entries.definition: Native provider communication container. Provider threads, inbox conversations, direct-message containers, and support conversations resolve here; a cross-provider history is a derived Entity view, not a synthetic mega-channel.
entries.stable_identity: logical active-channel resolution key platform plus connection_id plus container_id plus nullable thread_id
entries.revision_identity: Stored Channel row ID is version identity: channels.update soft-deletes the prior row and creates a successor row with a new ID and created_at; table uniqueness includes created_at
entries.observation_head_rule: Logical active-channel resolution key plus attribute or typed relationship slot; a historical Channel row ID is never treated as the eternal provider-thread identity.
forbidden_parallel_objects: MoonSleep-specific thread table that replaces native Channels

entries.definition: Effective participation of one Contact and optional Entity in one native Channel, with role and history.
entries.observation_head_rule: Participant ID plus attribute slot.
forbidden_parallel_objects: free-text participant arrays as canonical identity

entries.definition: Immutable bounded set of exact Record Revisions reviewed together for one coherent period or subject.
entries.stable_identity: Immutable evidence-set ID returned as episode_id, bound to exact Record Revision membership and sealed scope/member digests
entries.revision_identity: Episode membership is immutable; any membership or scope change creates a new Episode with a new episode_id
entries.observation_head_rule: Episode is a sealed evidence boundary, not an interpreted Resource field.
forbidden_parallel_objects: legacy Memory review Episode treated as continuous-evidence Episode authority

entries.definition: Immutable typed assertion supported by exact fragments from Record Revisions inside one Episode.
entries.revision_identity: Changed or corroborating evidence creates another Fact; prior Facts remain
entries.observation_head_rule: Facts are inputs to Observations and never project directly into Resources. Strict create_from_episode requires exactly one Episode and fails closed if any cited Record Revision is outside that Episode.
forbidden_parallel_objects: Fact citation outside its one governing Episode

entries.definition: Sorted immutable Fact membership and digest used as the complete bounded input to an Observation.

canonical_storage.surface: sealed sets and Observation input membership

entries.observation_head_rule: Several Observations may intentionally interpret the same sealed Fact set.

entries.definition: Versioned reviewed interpretation of one sealed Fact set for a Resource attribute or typed relationship. It carries uncertainty, contradiction state, business-effective timing, and semantic predecessor history.
entries.revision_identity: revision_number plus prior_observation_id within one head

canonical_storage.surface: Observation candidates, committed Observations, heads, and semantic receipts

canonical_storage.note: Immutable custody reference, not a copied Observation

entries.observation_head_rule: Attribute head is Resource class, Resource ID, and attribute path. Relationship head follows the registered single-valued slot or set-valued destination contract.
forbidden_parallel_objects: legacy Memory review Observation treated as semantic authority

entries.canonical_owner: Owning Resource domain with Nex Observation authority
entries.definition: Append-only receipt that one exact Nex Observation was applied to one registered Resource attribute. It is custody, not a second Resource or Observation.
entries.stable_identity: attribute projection link and receipt IDs
entries.revision_identity: Semantic predecessor remains the Nex Observation predecessor; current projection is derived
entries.observation_head_rule: Resource class, identity, and attribute path.
forbidden_parallel_objects: second active/superseded chain outside Nex Observation history

entries.canonical_owner: Owning Resource domain with Nex Observation authority
entries.definition: Append-only receipt that one exact Nex Observation was applied to one registered typed Resource relationship.
entries.stable_identity: relationship projection link and receipt IDs
entries.revision_identity: Semantic predecessor remains the Nex Observation predecessor
entries.observation_head_rule: Registered single-valued slot or set-valued destination identity.
forbidden_parallel_objects: relationship cardinality inferred from one chapter

entries.definition: Named or content-addressed membership collection used for job inputs, review packets, or derived cross-object collections. A Set never replaces the stable identity of its members.
entries.revision_identity: Sealed membership or a new Set
entries.observation_head_rule: Set is orchestration membership, not business truth.
forbidden_parallel_objects: synthetic multi-channel collection used as a reply route

entries.canonical_owner: Nex Channels and consuming read domain
entries.definition: Non-routable evidence or history view over an exact membership of native Channels and Records. It can group a multi-channel customer history or claims review corpus while every native Channel remains independently visible and replyable.
entries.stable_identity: content-addressed Set identity plus exact native Channel membership digest
entries.revision_identity: Changed membership creates a new sealed Set or collection revision
read_surfaces: planned shared derived Channel collection read
entries.observation_head_rule: Collection membership is a sealed read definition; Observations target the member Channels, Records, Entities, or business Resources.
open_questions: Shared read API and membership contract remain to be published

entries.definition: Durable execution request and run receipt. Jobs may produce candidate outputs but are never source evidence or business Resources.

canonical_storage.surface: jobs, runs, queue, idempotency, and DAG runtime

entries.observation_head_rule: Job outputs remain candidates until accepted by their owning contract.
forbidden_parallel_objects: job output treated as accepted Fact or Resource

entries.definition: Configured provider connection and its live-sync/backfill state. It supplies Records and identity observations but does not own business semantics.
entries.revision_identity: Connection configuration and monitor state history
entries.observation_head_rule: Operational configuration object.

entries.definition: Durable rule selecting runtime events that should enqueue governed work. Subscription breadth never changes evidence or action authority.
entries.observation_head_rule: Subscription is orchestration, not semantic truth.
forbidden_parallel_objects: fast recognizer required as a second mandatory stage

entries.definition: Durable operating context for an Entity or Agent, including identity and role-facing files. A Workspace is not a business customer, company, or case.
entries.observation_head_rule: Runtime context object.

entries.definition: Configured operating identity and behavior that can run Jobs or conversations within explicit authority. Agent output is candidate interpretation until accepted.
entries.stable_identity: agent ID backed by Entity identity
entries.observation_head_rule: Agent execution metadata is not business truth.

entries.canonical_owner: MoonSleep Customer Operations over Nex Identity and source-owned customer identities
entries.definition: Federated business-role view over a canonical Entity, Customer role, native Contacts, and source-owned customer identities. It is not a separate duplicate person table.
entries.stable_identity: canonical Nex Entity with Customer role plus reviewed provider identity links
entries.revision_identity: Entity/contact/role history remains with each owner; equivalence links are reviewed
entries.observation_head_rule: Customer facade field targets resolve to the owning Entity, Contact, role, or Customer Operations view field.
forbidden_parallel_objects: synthetic Customer IDs when an Entity and Customer role already exist
open_questions: Cross-channel equivalence promotion remains reviewable rather than universally automatic

entries.definition: Customer-facing history view that preserves each native Channel and provider conversation while presenting their combined chronology for one Customer. It is not a replacement Channel or reply route.
entries.stable_identity: Customer plus preserved native Channel identities; any support-thread identity remains Helpdesk-owned
entries.revision_identity: Derived from immutable communication occurrences and current identity links
entries.observation_head_rule: Thread-view fields must resolve to an owning native Channel, Customer, Issue, or Commitment target; no synthetic semantic history.
forbidden_parallel_objects: communication stream treated as native Channel
open_questions: The exact derived multi-Channel read contract needs central registration

entries.definition: Canonical support episode for one customer goal, question, exception, or remedy. One Channel may contain several Issues; acknowledgments or general history may create no Issue.
entries.stable_identity: Customer Operations issue ID derived from the exact initiating occurrence and issue-boundary contract
entries.revision_identity: Issue lifecycle events and reviewed successors preserve chronology

canonical_storage.surface: verified Customer Issue and issue lifecycle tables

entries.observation_head_rule: Issue ID plus attribute path or registered relationship slot.

entries.canonical_owner: General Commitment contract; accepting domain owns satisfaction evidence
entries.definition: General evidenced obligation, promise, accepted responsibility, policy-implied responsibility, or detected customer-affecting exception. It can concern any Entity and optionally Customer, Channel, Order, Issue, or other Resource.
entries.revision_identity: Explicit supersedes_commitment relationship; satisfaction requires owning receipt
entries.observation_head_rule: Commitment ID plus attribute path or registered relationship slot.
forbidden_parallel_objects: promise treated as completed without receipt

entries.canonical_owner: Owning mutation domain and resolution executor
entries.definition: Stable governed action identity and immutable provider/readback receipt. It separates proposed action, approval, execution, provider effect, reconciliation, and recovery.
entries.stable_identity: registered action ID plus domain receipt ID
entries.observation_head_rule: Owning action domain controls status and receipt history.
forbidden_parallel_objects: provider status without readback as completion

entries.canonical_owner: Commerce provider with Nex canonical commerce reference
entries.definition: Provider-native commerce order with stable Nex identity and MoonSleep operational projection. Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok retain provider truth.
entries.stable_identity: provider platform plus provider order ID, represented by commerce_order ID/order_key
entries.observation_head_rule: Canonical commerce_order ID plus registered attribute or relationship slot.
forbidden_parallel_objects: order number alone as cross-provider identity
current projection backdated as historical truth

entries.definition: Provider-native order line carrying purchased product/variant, quantity, and price identity.
entries.stable_identity: provider line ID represented by line_key
entries.revision_identity: commerce line observations and provider revisions
entries.observation_head_rule: Canonical line ID plus registered field or relationship.

entries.definition: Provider-native refund or adjustment with exact amount, currency, timing, and owning Order. A refund statement in email is not a Refund receipt.
entries.revision_identity: Provider refund events and immutable readback
entries.observation_head_rule: Provider refund identity plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: zero-dollar edit treated as monetary refund
email promise treated as refund completion

entries.definition: Canonical return request and lifecycle with provider readback, policy decision, affected lines, physical return path, and refund relationship.
entries.revision_identity: Return lifecycle events and policy decisions
entries.observation_head_rule: Return case ID plus registered field or relationship.

entries.definition: Stable component-level obligation created by an Order line and satisfied only through authoritative allocation/package/shipment evidence.
entries.observation_head_rule: Obligation ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: order status as fulfillment obligation state

entries.definition: Expected fulfillment grouping and route for one or more component obligations. A plan is not a physical shipment.
entries.observation_head_rule: Delivery plan ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: shipment created from a promise or ETA

entries.definition: Dispatch package attempt and its composition, label, node, wave, and physical carrier evidence. Tracking number is an attribute until a broader transport identity is approved.
entries.revision_identity: Package state and tracking event history
entries.observation_head_rule: Package attempt ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: tracking string as standalone Resource without owner decision
open_questions: A cross-domain transport identity may later generalize package tracking

entries.definition: Executable or planned node-scoped grouping of fulfillment packages. A wave does not prove carrier possession.
entries.revision_identity: Wave lifecycle and packet publication history
entries.observation_head_rule: Wave ID plus registered field or relationship.

entries.definition: Operational Dispatch node identity, distinct from but explicitly related to a physical Facility and partner Organization.
entries.observation_head_rule: Node ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: Facility and Node collapsed into one identity

entries.definition: MoonSleep operational incident affecting an Order or fulfillment package, independent from a provider claim case.
entries.revision_identity: Incident events and reviewed attribute/relationship Observations
entries.observation_head_rule: Incident ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: customer issue copied as carrier incident

entries.definition: Provider-native claim, trace, or recovery case associated with an operational Carrier Incident.
entries.stable_identity: carrier_case_id; natural uniqueness provider_name plus provider_account_ref plus external_case_number when present
entries.observation_head_rule: Carrier case ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: provider acknowledgment as approval or recovery

entries.definition: Immutable event in one Carrier Case, with exact source and idempotency custody.
entries.observation_head_rule: Event identity is immutable; interpretations target owning Incident or Case fields.
forbidden_parallel_objects: event as business Resource when it only changes a Case

entries.canonical_owner: Claims for case linkage; Finance for cash/accounting meaning
entries.definition: Exact provider credit, remittance, or recovery receipt tied to a Carrier Case. Provider status alone is not recovery.
entries.revision_identity: Immutable provider receipt and reconciliation history
entries.observation_head_rule: Receipt ID plus registered field or relationship.
open_questions: Provider credit and remittance links to Finance need a shared typed contract

entries.canonical_owner: Owning partner registry over Nex Entity
entries.definition: Business-role facade for a supplier, carrier, creator, facility operator, or service provider represented by canonical Nex Entities and Contacts.
entries.stable_identity: canonical Nex Organization Entity plus reviewed partner role and provider references
entries.revision_identity: Entity/role/contact history and owner-specific agreement history
entries.observation_head_rule: Partner view fields target owning Entity, role, agreement, or domain Resource.
forbidden_parallel_objects: provider text as a new Organization
open_questions: Supply and Finance party tables require enforced Entity crosswalks

entries.canonical_owner: Supply compatibility storage with Nex Organization target
entries.definition: Existing Supply organization row used by product and procurement tables. It must crosswalk to the canonical Nex Organization Entity rather than becoming a competing identity authority.
entries.stable_identity: organization_id pending mandatory Nex Entity crosswalk
entries.observation_head_rule: New partner facts should target the canonical Entity/Partner once crosswalked.
open_questions: Mandatory supply_organization to Nex Entity crosswalk is not production-enforced

entries.definition: Stable commercial/product concept that can have revisions, prototypes, BOMs, experiments, purchase plans, and commercial variants.
entries.observation_head_rule: product_family_id plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: SKU or prototype substituted for Product Family

entries.definition: Effective-dated version of a Product Family's design and requirements.
entries.observation_head_rule: product_revision_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: BOM version collapsed into Product Revision

entries.definition: Versioned bill of materials for one Product Revision.
entries.observation_head_rule: bom_version_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: mutable component list without BOM version

entries.definition: One component requirement within a BOM Version.
entries.observation_head_rule: bom_line_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: free-text component obligation as BOM identity

entries.definition: Planned or realized prototype design identity, distinct from each physical Sample Article.
entries.observation_head_rule: prototype_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: physical sample collapsed into prototype identity

entries.definition: Structured product hypothesis and evaluation over one or more options or prototypes.
entries.observation_head_rule: experiment_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: informal preference promoted to experiment without decision

entries.definition: One tested alternative and result within a Product Experiment.
entries.observation_head_rule: experiment_option_id plus field or relationship.

entries.definition: Pre-commitment procurement plan evaluating requirements, suppliers, product quotes, and freight options. It is not a Purchase Order.
entries.observation_head_rule: purchase_plan_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: plan treated as committed Purchase Order

entries.definition: One supplier/product/freight alternative evaluated inside a Purchase Plan.
entries.observation_head_rule: purchase_plan_option_id plus field or relationship.

entries.definition: One quantity, component, product, or service requirement inside a Purchase Plan or option.
entries.observation_head_rule: purchase_plan_requirement_id plus field or relationship.

entries.definition: Versioned supplier-issued commercial quotation for product/components, distinct from a Purchase Order or Invoice.
evidence_inputs: supplier communication and document Record Revisions
entries.observation_head_rule: product_quotation_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: quote as Purchase Order or Invoice

entries.definition: One priced quantity break or resource line within a Supplier Product Quotation.
entries.revision_identity: Inherited from quotation and Observation history
entries.observation_head_rule: product_quote_line_id plus field or relationship.

entries.definition: One supplier-proposed packaging configuration attached to a Product Quotation, preserving package and carton assumptions separately from price lines.
entries.revision_identity: Inherited from quotation and Observation history
entries.observation_head_rule: product_quote_packaging_option_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: packaging assumption copied into product identity

entries.definition: Supplier or forwarder-issued freight quotation with transport mode, service scope, incoterm, and priced lines.
entries.observation_head_rule: freight_quotation_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: freight quote as shipment or invoice

entries.definition: One priced cargo/service alternative within a Supplier Freight Quotation.
entries.revision_identity: Inherited from quotation and Observation history
entries.observation_head_rule: freight_quote_line_id plus field or relationship.

entries.definition: Supplier-facing order for prototypes or samples, distinct from commercial Purchase Orders and Customer Orders.
entries.observation_head_rule: sample_order_id plus field or relationship.

entries.definition: One product revision/BOM quantity within a Sample Order.
entries.revision_identity: Inherited from order and Observation history
entries.observation_head_rule: sample_order_line_id plus field or relationship.

entries.definition: Effective status assertion for one Sample Order, preserving source precision.
entries.observation_head_rule: Status event is immutable; current state is derived.

entries.definition: One physical sample article realizing a prototype or product revision and fulfilling a Sample Order Line.
entries.observation_head_rule: sample_article_id plus field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: prototype design and physical sample collapsed

entries.definition: Effective status assertion for one physical Sample Article.
entries.observation_head_rule: Status event immutable; current article state derived.

entries.canonical_owner: Supply evidence; Finance owns actual payment truth
entries.definition: Source-supported report that a Sample Order payment occurred. It is evidence and not necessarily a canonical Payment.
entries.observation_head_rule: Report ID plus field or relationship; Payment promotion requires Finance receipt.

entries.definition: Commercial procurement commitment issued to a supplier, distinct from a Purchase Plan, quote, Invoice, or Sample Order.
entries.revision_identity: PO status, line, lot, and payment histories
entries.observation_head_rule: PO ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: Purchase Plan or Invoice as PO

entries.definition: Distinct purchased/produced inventory lot tied to a Purchase Order and physical receipt history. Lot and business Batch remain distinct.
entries.revision_identity: ETA, shipment, receipt, and allocation history
entries.observation_head_rule: Lot ID plus registered field or relationship.

entries.definition: Source-owned stock position facet by component, variant, node, lot, or location, retaining physical basis, reserve, allocations, and reconciliation.
entries.stable_identity: position identity defined by owning inventory surface

canonical_storage.surface: Inventory Ledger and inventory position views

entries.observation_head_rule: Owning position identity plus registered field or relationship.

entries.definition: Physical facility/location identity, distinct from a Dispatch Node and related explicitly to a Partner Organization.
entries.observation_head_rule: Facility ID plus registered field or relationship.

entries.definition: Registered Finance source lane, revisioned extraction contract, and required control set. It governs coverage and capture; it is not a Financial Account or business Resource.
entries.stable_identity: source_stream_id with natural uniqueness source_system plus source_environment plus source_account_ref plus stream_name
entries.observation_head_rule: Finance source custody is not semantic business history.

entries.definition: Content-addressed encrypted Finance evidence object with separate envelope, key-wrapper, and storage-location custody. It is source material, never an Invoice, Payment, Transaction, or semantic Observation by itself.
entries.revision_identity: Immutable content object; new bytes create a new identity
evidence_inputs: captured Finance document or provider payload
entries.observation_head_rule: Evidence objects support Facts; they do not hold semantic current state.
forbidden_parallel_objects: one evidence object as one Invoice

entries.definition: Immutable finalized or quarantined coverage manifest tying a source-stream revision to evidence objects and control results.
entries.revision_identity: A new capture creates a new manifest sequence; finalized manifests are immutable
entries.observation_head_rule: Manifest membership supports Facts but never replaces Nex semantic Observations.
forbidden_parallel_objects: manifest as Invoice, Payment, or Transaction

entries.canonical_owner: Finance evidence bridge; Nex owns general Record and Record Revision evidence
entries.definition: Finance-owned immutable source reference used by ledger and AP foreign keys. It is a custody bridge, not a second semantic Record system.
entries.stable_identity: source_record_id; unique source_system plus external_reference plus content_sha256
read_surfaces: Finance ledger and AP source links
entries.observation_head_rule: Canonical semantic interpretation remains in Nex Facts and Observations.
open_questions: Exact mandatory Nex Record Revision crosswalk is not universal

entries.definition: Stable AP subledger party identity referenced by Invoices. It is not another Organization and must crosswalk to a canonical Partner or Nex Organization Entity before claiming shared identity.
entries.stable_identity: ap_party_id derived and guarded from identity_material_sha256
entries.revision_identity: party_status and source evidence; shared Organization equivalence remains reviewed
evidence_inputs: Finance source record and reviewed party identity
entries.observation_head_rule: AP party ID plus Finance-owned field; shared Entity equivalence uses a separately reviewed relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: provider recipient as durable Partner identity
open_questions: Mandatory crosswalk to Partner or Nex Entity is unresolved

entries.definition: Stable general-ledger account identity. Provider-native cash and card registrations are separate supporting objects and may optionally bind an exact Account Revision.
entries.observation_head_rule: Account ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: supplier-specific GL account for AP detail
provider mapping as another ledger account

entries.canonical_owner: Provider for native identity; Finance for governed registration
entries.definition: Registered provider-native cash, credit-card, or charge-card account. It has its own identity and optionally links to an exact Financial Account revision.
entries.stable_identity: cash_card_account_id derived from source_system plus source_environment plus source_account_ref_sha256
entries.observation_head_rule: Cash/card account ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: provider account mapping as a ledger account

entries.canonical_owner: Provider for native truth; Finance for owned history and classification
entries.definition: Provider-native cash or card transaction with append-only revisions and an explicitly selected logical current head.
entries.stable_identity: cash_card_account_id plus external_transaction_ref_sha256, represented by transaction_id
entries.revision_identity: transaction_revision_id and revision_number; selected logical head is a read contract
entries.observation_head_rule: Transaction ID plus registered field; latest revision number is not automatically current truth.
forbidden_parallel_objects: raw, compact, or projected view as another transaction system
open_questions: Typed reconciliation to Payment, Refund, Invoice, and Journal requires a registered join object

entries.definition: Stable payable document identity for one supplier obligation. An email, attachment, candidate, queue row, or payment notice is not an Invoice.
entries.stable_identity: ap_invoice_id derived from stable_invoice_identity_sha256 and ap_party_id
entries.revision_identity: ap_invoice_revision_id with monotonic sequence and superseded_revision_id
entries.observation_head_rule: Invoice ID plus registered field or relationship; semantic history remains in Nex Observations.
forbidden_parallel_objects: Luna candidate or intake as Invoice
open_questions: Credit document profile field needs standardization
Direct Partner or Nex Entity relationship waits for the AP Party crosswalk

entries.definition: Effective immutable version of an Invoice's financial and review fields.
entries.observation_head_rule: Invoice revision fields are projections of accepted Observations; the revision row is not a second Observation store.

entries.definition: One priced and classified line within an exact Invoice Revision. Cross-domain PO or Claim references require a separate governed typed relationship; source evidence locator text is not that relationship.
entries.observation_head_rule: Invoice line ID plus registered field or relationship.
forbidden_parallel_objects: copied Supply or Claims state inside invoice line

entries.canonical_owner: Provider for execution; Finance for governed identity and matching
entries.definition: Provider-native AP payment order and lifecycle evidence, deployed today for Mercury only. It is distinct from cash/card transactions and supplier-reported payment statements.
entries.stable_identity: provider_name plus provider_object_identity_sha256 represented by ap_payment_order_id
entries.observation_head_rule: Payment ID plus registered field or relationship.
open_questions: PayPal and other provider registration remains a gap

entries.definition: Governed allocation or reversal effect between one exact Payment Revision and one exact Invoice Revision.
entries.observation_head_rule: Exact Invoice Revision and Payment Revision relationship slot.

entries.definition: Balanced accounting entry with explicit idempotency, document reference, source links, and reversal relationship.
entries.stable_identity: entry_id; document_reference and idempotency_key are separately unique while payload_sha256 is content custody
entries.revision_identity: Explicit reversal_of_entry_id references the original Entry
entries.observation_head_rule: Journal Entry and line fields remain ledger-owned; source links preserve evidence.
forbidden_parallel_objects: accepted Observation as posted Journal Entry
QBO as current owner without adoption

entries.definition: One debit or credit line in a balanced Journal Entry, bound to an exact Financial Account revision.
entries.revision_identity: Owned by immutable posted Entry or explicit reversal
entries.observation_head_rule: Ledger-owned line identity.

entries.definition: Bounded accounting period whose only allowed state chain is open to review_only to locked. Locked periods are immutable; cross-layer freshness remains separate report data.
entries.revision_identity: Append-only finance.audit_events with subject_area accounting_period and event_action period_state_changed; no reopen path
entries.observation_head_rule: Period identity plus Finance-owned certification fields.
forbidden_parallel_objects: one freshness timestamp for all Finance layers

entries.canonical_owner: Finance compatibility; Nex owns semantic Observations
entries.definition: Existing Finance-local observation and fact-link tables retained for compatibility. They may reference or project canonical Nex semantics but must not create an independent Observation history.
entries.revision_identity: Compatibility only; superseded_observation_id mirrors local linkage while canonical predecessor chain is nex.observation
entries.observation_head_rule: Canonical history is always the Nex Observation head.
open_questions: Define retirement or regeneration from canonical Nex Observations

open_gaps.title: Seven historical Shopify Records lack canonical Record Revision registration
open_gaps.decision: Keep the existing Records and Orders. Register immutable revisions from the durable source payloads through the canonical registrar before using them as Episode members; no provider refetch or new Order schema is implied.

open_gaps.title: Seven historical Gmail conversations have communication projections but no native Channel/participant Contact materialization
open_gaps.decision: Run a bounded historical identity and Channel replay through the current adapter machinery. Do not manually create a MoonSleep thread table or new Customer Entities.

open_gaps.title: Shared reviewed projection needs typed adapters for all registered canonical targets
open_gaps.owner: Nex semantic foundation and each owning domain
open_gaps.decision: Extend the closed target and relationship registry so Observations can address existing objects in place. Never copy native Contacts, Orders, Entities, Channels, or Issues into a parallel Resource store.

open_gaps.title: Supply organization compatibility IDs are not yet mandatorily crosswalked to Nex Organization Entities
open_gaps.decision: Add an evidence-backed mandatory reference/crosswalk; do not merge or recreate organizations from provider text.

open_gaps.title: Finance AP party IDs are not yet production-enforced against canonical Nex Organization Entities
open_gaps.decision: Register a typed party-to-Entity relationship with evidence and review; retain AP party as subledger identity without making it a second Organization.

open_gaps.title: Finance-local observation tables need explicit compatibility and retirement semantics
open_gaps.decision: Mark them as references/projections of canonical Nex Observations, define regeneration or retirement, and prohibit an independent predecessor chain.

open_gaps.title: Payment registration covers Mercury AP payment orders but not PayPal or other providers
open_gaps.decision: Register provider-native account and payment identities before they participate. Do not overload PayPal into Mercury identity and do not infer a Payment from an email, amount, or creator statement alone.

open_gaps.title: Finance cross-domain reconciliation and source-resource links lack deployed typed join contracts
open_gaps.owner: Finance with Commerce, Inventory, Supply, and Claims
open_gaps.decision: Define exact join storage, stable identity, cardinality, owner, and evidence before projecting Invoice-to-PO, Invoice-Line-to-Claim, Transaction-to-Payment-or-Refund, Sample-Payment-to-Payment, or Recovery-to-Transaction relationships.

open_gaps.title: Tracking and transport identity remains split across Dispatch package attempts and source-owned carrier evidence
open_gaps.decision: Reuse Fulfillment Package today and preserve ambiguous tracking as Observations. Generalize only after an owner and stable cross-domain transport identity are proven.

open_gaps.title: Cross-Channel customer histories and evidence collections need one registered derived read contract
open_gaps.owner: Nex Channels, Customer Operations, and consuming review domains
open_gaps.decision: Define a non-routable, content-addressed derived collection that preserves every native Channel and reply route. Reuse it for Customer history and claims evidence grouping without creating a synthetic cross-provider Channel identity.
